info.title: CISLIB Central Management API
info.description: Independent authenticated service. API versions, client versions and authoritative application identities are distinct. This document describes twelve typed operations; no remote code execution, configuration distribution or Audit archive is exposed.

x-cis-request-validation: Reject duplicate decoded keys, malformed UTF8/Unicode, explicit forbidden null and unknown fields in closed request objects. Runtime enforces x-cis byte/identity/calendar/reference rules.
x-cis-response-evolution: Tolerate optional additions and preserve unrecognized status strings as explicit unknown; never a successful default.
